Application Data.NAME: Sunny Side Diner
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunny Side Diner is a full-service restaurant specializing in classic American diner fare, offering breakfast, lunch, and dinner options. We pride ourselves on our friendly atmosphere and commitment to high-quality ingredients. Our menu features a variety of dishes, including signature breakfast items, burgers, salads, and homemade desserts. Additionally, we serve a selection of craft beers and wines, with alcohol sales comprising less than 30% of our total revenue. Our restaurant is family-friendly, with seating capacity for 120 patrons and a floor area of 5,000 sq ft. We also offer catering services for local events, which account for less than 5% of our sales. We do not rely on third-party food delivery platforms for significant revenue, ensuring quality control and safety in our food handling processes.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a grease fire in the kitchen caused damage to the exhaust system, resulting in repair costs of $6,000. The fire was contained and no injuries occurred. The claim is currently open and under review. On 07/22/2023, a slip-and-fall incident on the premises resulted in a claim for medical expenses amounting to $4,000; this claim has been settled successfully.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras and motion sensors installed throughout the premises, along with regular inspections by a licensed monitoring service.
